dedupe_keys.name: pest model calibration and uncertainty suite

description: PEST++ is a model-independent suite supported by USGS, GNS Science, Intera and contributors for parameter estimation and decisions under uncertainty. It provides deterministic inversion, iterative ensemble smoothing, global sensitivity analysis, parallel model runs, chance-constrained optimisation and data assimilation. Inputs are an external numerical model, parameter definitions and observations; outputs include calibrated parameters, uncertainty ensembles and management alternatives. Coverage and temporal resolution follow the linked model. Source is free under a worldwide CC0 dedication, with a US public-domain statement, user manual and build instructions. A limitation is that calibration cannot remove structural model error, and useful results require suitable observations and parameterisation. PEST++ can calibrate water-infrastructure and environmental simulations without changing their internal code. USGS water APIs (data-usgs-water-data-apis) provide related observations. The software was not built or run and no calibration dataset was downloaded.
